info.title: Confera admin API
info.description: The API of the admin surface. It answers only under the admin host name.

post.summary:
Asks for an email change; needs the current password. A link to confirm it goes to the
new address, a notice to the old one and to every active admin. 409 `email_taken` when
the address belongs to an account already.

post.summary:
Changes the own password; needs the current one. Ends every other session of the user,
and tells every active admin. A new password that breaks a rule is refused with 400
`password_refused` and each broken rule named (`password_length`, `password_common`,
`password_personal`, `password_mismatch`).

post.summary:
Uploads an email image: multipart, one part `file`, at most 5 MB. PNG, JPEG or GIF by
content (415 `image_type_refused` otherwise, SVG included); at most 8,000 pixels a side
and 16 megapixels by its header (422 `image_too_many_pixels`); 422 `image_unreadable`
when it cannot be decoded in time; re-encoded at most 600 pixels wide and 200 KB (413
`image_too_large`). Its scan is pending until ClamAV says clean.

post.summary:
Resends the message of this entry (FR-SMTP-05): as it was sent, with a fresh secure link
that ends the earlier one, or rendered again from the template when the content was not
kept. 409 `resend_refused` for a test message, an email change confirmation, a message
that is not done yet, and a link that is no longer true (it failed as stale, or the
password or the address changed after it was asked for; SEC-M4-02).

Signs in. Every failure answers alike (401 `sign_in_failed`), after the same time: an
unknown address, a wrong password, a braked account or address, an account that is
deactivated, invited or removed. Sets the session cookie and, for a browser that was
not a known device of the account, the device cookie.

actor.description: Who did it; null for the system (a summary).

action.description: One of the actions of the audit log, for example `user.role_changed`.

fields.description: The names of the fields that changed.

changes.description: Old and new value, only for the fields whose values the log keeps (settings that are not personal).

detail.description: Counts and periods of a summary.

field.description: The field's key, as in the configuration's `fields`.

requiredByDefault.description: Required unless the admin says otherwise (a mandatory field: always as here).

options.description: The values of its options, whose labels an admin may change; null without options.

maxLengthCap.description: The most characters an admin may allow; null when the field has no such limit.

maxWordsCap.description: The most words an admin may allow; null when the field counts no words.

fileTypes.description: The file types an admin may let a file field take; null for another field.

password.description: The current password: an email change needs it (ADR-03).

newEmail.description: The new address. The change is confirmed from it.

newPasswordRepeat.description: The second entry of the new password: both entries must match.

state.description:
`draft`; `open`: the forms take submissions (the action is called "Open for
submissions", D10); `closed`: they take none ("Close submissions"); `archived`: final.

code.description: Two capital letters: IT, ER, EM, LI, AI.

timeZone.description: An IANA time zone, for example Europe/Belgrade.

publicationTermsUrl.description: The terms of publication the consent of its forms links to (D6); https, or null.

privacyNoticeUrl.description: The privacy notice the consent of its forms links to (D6); https, or null.

confirmationValidUntil.description: The password asked again is valid until this moment, in this session only.

listedSites.description: At most 20; each is checked and kept as an origin (ST-30).

publicationTermsUrl.description: An https address without a user part (the consent's "terms" link, D6). Null clears it.

privacyNoticeUrl.description: An https address without a user part (the consent's "privacy" link, D6). Null clears it.

subject.description: A subject document (contracts/template-vectors.json); markup in its place is refused.

body.description: A body document (contracts/template-vectors.json); markup in its place is refused.

endsOn.description:
The last day, inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD, in the conference's time zone: what a person reads
("Ends 31 Dec 2099", UX3-08). It is what an admin sets and what is stored.

endsAt.description:
The exclusive end: the instant it closes, the start of the day after `endsOn` in the
conference's time zone (`endsOn` 2099-12-31 in Europe/Belgrade: 2099-12-31T23:00:00.000Z).
For comparisons and countdowns, not to show as the last day.

newEmail.description: The address the account will have once the change is confirmed.

path.description: Path of the field in the request, for example `authors.0.email`.

code.description: Stable code of the rule that failed, for example `isEmail`. Never the value.

state.description: What the public form shows now.

configuration.description: The draft: what the admin set over the catalogue (contracts/form-configuration.schema.json).

draftDefinition.description: The definition the draft makes, for the preview (contracts/form-definition.schema.json).

currentVersion.description: The published version the public form shows; null before the first publish.

breakerPerHour.description: The send breaker of this form (ADR-08): confirmations above these are held.

catalogue.description: The catalogue of its type: what the configuration may change (M3-ISS-05).

currentVersionNumber.description: The number of the published version, null before the first publish.

heldBy.description:
The numbers of the hold (UX3-06): `count` confirmations in the last `windowHours` hours,
this one included, above `limit` (for `recipient_domain`: submissions to that domain in
24 hours, limit 100). Null for an email held before the numbers were kept.

email.description: The address the invitation goes to; the user signs in with it.

expiresAt.description: The link stops working at this moment.

name.description: The name it was uploaded under, cleaned (with the extension of what it is now).

type.description: What it is now: png or jpeg (a GIF became a PNG of its first frame).

scanState.description: pending until ClamAV has said clean; only a clean image is shown or sent.

serverName.description: The name of the server when it was used.

errorCode.description: A code, never the server's words.

diverted.description:
True when the attempt went to the mail catcher of the staging server and not to the
configured server (ADR-27, ST-50); `recipient` is still the original recipient.

subject.description: The subject as sent (M2-ISS-14), with every secure link as `[link]`; null when the organisation keeps no content.

resendOf.description: The message this attempt resent (FR-SMTP-05), and how: `copy` or `rendered_again`.

imageIds.description: The email images the body showed: their ids, not their bytes (ADR-13).

days.description: Days; 730 (24 months) on a fresh install.

version.description: The version of the organisation profile.

serverName.description: The name of the server when it was used.

errorCode.description: A code, never the server's words.

diverted.description:
True when the attempt went to the mail catcher of the staging server and not to the
configured server (ADR-27, ST-50); `recipient` is still the original recipient.

subject.description: The subject as sent (M2-ISS-14), with every secure link as `[link]`; null when the organisation keeps no content.

resendOf.description: The message this attempt resent (FR-SMTP-05), and how: `copy` or `rendered_again`.

tlsMode.description: implicit (TLS from the first byte), starttls (required), none (developer machines only).

credentialSet.description: Whether a password is stored. The password itself is never returned.

credentialSetAt.description: When the stored password was set.

isDefault.description: The organisation's default server, last in the order of FR-SMTP-02.

isFallback.description: Tried when sending through the chosen server fails.

sendRatePerMinute.description: Messages a minute the worker sends through this server at most.

subject.description: A subject document: type subject, with text and placeholder children.

body.description: A body document: type doc, with block children.

mailServerId.description: The server of this template, first in the order of FR-SMTP-02.

instance.description:
`staging` on the staging server (every screen shows the staging banner, ADR-27),
`production` on production, null on a developer machine.

version.description:
Version of the API (SemVer), the same as `info.version` of the OpenAPI document.
A client built for another major version must stop and ask for a reload.
The version of the organisation profile.

name.description: The short name shown in the application.

vatNoteSr.description: The note on documents that the association is exempt from VAT, in Serbian.

rsdAccount.description: The account for payments in RSD.

paypalPayee.description: The PayPal account that receives payments.

paymentDetailsChangedAt.description: When the payment details were changed last; the issue screen shows it for 14 days.

mailLogContent.description: Whether the mail log keeps the subject and body of what was sent (FR-SMTP-04).

version.description: Sent back with a change: a change made on an older version is refused (409).

password.description: The password of the signed-in user, asked again before a sensitive change.

code.description: Stable, machine-readable code, for example `not_found` or `validation_failed`.

traceId.description: Identifies this request in the server log.

status.description: HTTP status. Absent on an unknown error.

title.description: Short English name of the status. Absent on an unknown error.

errors.description: The refused fields, when the input was not valid.

email.description: The address of the account. The answer is the same whether it belongs to one or not.

csrf.description:
The value of the `X-CSRF-Token` header that every changing request of this session
carries (ADR-03). Bound to the session; never in a cookie.

idleExpiresAt.description: The session ends at this moment unless it is used before (24 hours after the last use).

absoluteExpiresAt.description: The session ends at this moment whatever happens (7 days after sign-in).

confirmationValidUntil.description: Until when the password asked again is valid in this session; null when it was not asked.

secondFactor.description: The step of the second factor (built in 0.9.0): not_required, pending or passed.

roles.description: The roles of the user: admin, reviewer.

passwordRepeat.description: The second entry: both entries must match.

email.description: The email address of the account.

reason.description: The internal reason: required to withdraw and to reopen, refused otherwise; never sent.

message.description:
The text for the author, carried by the email word for word: required to return for
revision, allowed to reject, withdraw and reopen, refused otherwise.

sends.description: False when the conference switched this email off (FR-MAIL-07): nothing will be sent.

html.description: The HTML with its images embedded: show it in a sandboxed frame only (ST-28).

previewDigest.description: Send it back with the change (every action but `open`, SEC-M4-05).

reason.description: The internal reason: required to withdraw and to reopen, refused otherwise; never sent.

message.description:
The text for the author, carried by the email word for word: required to return for
revision, allowed to reject, withdraw and reopen, refused otherwise.

actions.description: The changes of status an admin may make now, in the order of the state table.

answers.description: The answers by field key, as checked (contracts/form-rule-vectors.json).

version.description: Raised by every change of status or data: send it with the next change (409 otherwise).

status.description: queued, sending, sent, failed, held, stuck, waiting_for_server or discarded.

heldBy.description: The numbers of the hold, as in the held emails (UX3-06); null when not held or unknown.

scanFlag.description:
`macros`: an old .doc with macros, accepted and flagged for the office (G2-22);
`external_links`: a .docx with a remote template, frame or object, or a UNC path (SEC-M3-06).

downloadBlocked.description: Null: it may be downloaded. Otherwise why not, yet or ever (UX3-07).

field.description: The file field of the form it was uploaded for.

scannedAt.description: When the scan ended, or since when it waits.

nextScanAt.description: Pending: when the next scan is due.

flags.description: The flags its files carry, each once, in this order: macros, external_links.

scanPending.description: Whether a file still waits for its virus scan.

total.description: All rows that match the search and the filters, on every page.

before.description: The values of those keys before and after; the first revision's `before` is the original.

email.description: `queued`: the email is `emailId`; `template_off`: no email, switched off (FR-MAIL-07); `none`.

transition.description: The row of the state table: 1 (the form), 2, 4 to 9.

actor.description: Null for the author's own submit (transition 1).

reason.description: The internal reason of a withdrawal or a reopening: for the admins only, never sent.

message.description: The text for the author that the email carried (FR-MAIL-08).

version.description: Raised by every change of status or data: send it with the next change (409 otherwise).

imagesPending.description: Images of the body not shown yet: their virus scan is not clean (yet).

conferenceId.description: The conference whose name the sample shows; the organisation's otherwise.

statusEmail.description: A status email (FR-MAIL-03): one per change of status; it can be switched off per conference.

carriesLink.description: Whether a message of this type carries a secure link: the address of a link node.

cause.description:
With `failed`, what kind of failure it was (M2-ISS-14, UXUI-M2-11), as a code and never
the server's words: `connection_failed` (no connection, or none in time),
`certificate_refused`, `authentication_failed`, `recipient_refused` or `send_failed`.

listedSites.description: At most 20; each is checked and kept as an origin (ST-30).

publicationTermsUrl.description: An https address without a user part (the consent's "terms" link, D6). Null clears it.

privacyNoticeUrl.description: An https address without a user part (the consent's "privacy" link, D6). Null clears it.

mailServerId.description: Null removes the template's own server; left out, it stays.

mailLogContent.description: Whether the mail log keeps the content of what was sent (FR-SMTP-04).

invitationDelivery.description:
For an invited user, what became of the latest invitation message: `queued` (to be
sent), `waiting_for_server` (no mail server can send it yet; it goes out once one is
configured, with a link made then), `sent` or `failed`. Null for anyone else, and for
an invitation that was given by hand (the first admin).

status.description: invited (no password yet), active, deactivated or removed.

version.description: Sent back with a change: a change made on an older version is refused (409).

total.description: How many users match, over all pages.

version.description: The version the change is made on.
